statement: Crop water needs depend on climate, crop type, and growth stage.
Hotter, drier, windier and sunnier conditions generally increase crop water needs.
notes: Directional principle, not an irrigation prescription.

statement: Crop-water need in the FAO reference is related to evapotranspiration under optimal growing conditions.
Broad crop-water ranges are not a substitute for local irrigation scheduling.
Soil fertility and limitations should be assessed rather than assumed from crop name or location alone.
Nutrient recommendations should be balanced and adapted to soil status and the crop/cropping system.
Integrated nutrient management may combine inorganic and organic nutrient sources; the mix and rates depend on the applicable recommendation.
Crop varieties and production technologies need to match their agro-ecological suitability.
When required details or applicable evidence are missing, ask for information or mark the assessment undetermined.
notes: CropNova safety policy informed by source limitations.
